Ellington Eaton Square official project brief

review.gallery: Nine original Eaton Square renders from the official brochure and project brief. The fitted office is an interior concept for a shell-and-core building.
review.location: Page 6 of the developer brief locates the tower beside Ras Al Khor Road. Heart Homes publishes the development coordinates for the same plus-code address given by Global X. A separate Mitchell’s vicinity pin is about 62 metres east. The 25- and 27-minute Media City estimates are both retained. Metro alignment is qualified as proposed.
review.floorPlans: 21 full drawings. Six typical plates, thirteen floor-specific SPA sheets and two amenity plans. Printed areas checked visually. Special Unit 01 is 21,412.01 sq ft combined on the typical sheet and 21,412 sq ft on the SPA drawing.

unavailable: Exact visitor entrance, standalone retail or parking drawings and individually executed sale schedules were not established.
